authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, section 10.2 specifies a true bit following the maximum class number and two zero RC values in the R2004+ CLASSES header.
finding: Both the shared R2004-family and R2007+ CLASSES writers emitted false. Independent physical decoding showed max=564, RC=0/0, bit=0 on the old generated AC1021 output, versus max=514, RC=0/0, bit=1 in the ODA-generated control SHA-256 f3bb8e438a7df7ecb2a45535f548e8b035af253272d8b70cfa6056e7ec32dae3.
change: Emit true at this existing one-bit field in both dwgWriter18 and dwgWriter24; AC1015 uses a different section layout and is unchanged. No class ordinal, manifest, or placeholder identity is altered.

validation.coverage: Generated complete AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027 and AC1032 DWGs are decoded through their physical container sections; their CLASSES headers each contain RC=0/0, bit=1 and the immediately following class number 500, and the existing version-specific reader accepts each section. HEADER writer and source-reference controls pass.
validation.oldInputCompatibility: The current reader still accepts the pre-fix generated AC1021 SHA-256 0181777ea2b8963e83992984b4d138215438c74d1e6061cba2b6265fb8bc0e86, whose CLASSES header bit is false; the ordinary DWG sample probe succeeds with zero recorded CRC, entity, object or integrity errors.

independentConverter.operation: ACAD2013 DXF, recursion disabled, audit disabled
independentConverter.result: The freshly generated one-LINE AC1021 output has the corrected true bit but the converter returns zero with only an .err reporting Invalid input and no DXF.
independentConverter.interpretation: The bit is a spec-backed writer defect independently corroborated by the ODA control. Its correction does not resolve the broader rejection.

limits: The experimental unique-placeholder-names drawing was also rejected by ODA; it does not prove placeholders are valid. Spec section 20.4 describes object type minus 500 as a class-list index, so placeholder removal or class renumbering requires separate reference/ordinal proof and is not part of this change.
No external fixture was committed or support claim promoted.
